statements.statement: The procedure code billed was CPT 93271
The diagnosis codes were I25.10 and I34.0
The denial reason code was CO-97
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
Cardiac event monitoring was ordered to correlate clinical events with rhythm disturbances and evaluate for potential arrhythmias
The service was denied as bundled into another covered procedure
